title: StoryLens local web production mode

commits.message: Add StoryLens local web production mode (CHG-20260721-015).

user_summary: 增加正式本地网页版：浏览器访问本机FastAPI静态站，复用现有React与业务后端，数据与凭据仍在本机，保留Tauri桌面版并支持浏览器缩放。
technical_summary: Add browser_local_production shell: FastAPI serves React SPA on 127.0.0.1:8765, GET /api/v1/runtime capability adapter, loopback Origin guard, instance lock, LOCALAPPDATA data root, start/stop scripts.
acceptance_criteria: Local web starts on http://127.0.0.1:8765 with SPA + API same origin
Runtime API reports browser_local_production; desktop updater hidden in web
Data uses LOCALAPPDATA\\StoryLens; credentials stay server-side
Idempotent start script; remote Origin rejected

data_compatibility.notes: Shares production SQLite root with desktop; web mode acquires instance lock.
